raw: {"verdict": "pass", "reason": "The root cause was `localTimeToUtc` applying the offset from the start of the date to every time that day. The patch now resolves the offset for the specific wall time, including DST-ambiguous and nonexistent times, and I traced Berlin 28 Mar and 31 Oct 2027 to the correct 10:00 local. It also fixes the admin day-end calculation to use the next local midnight instead of adding a fixed 24 hours."}
